# CyberWorld Builders
> Useful systems. Unusual ideas. An independent technology workshop where Jay Long explores human–AI collaboration, creative tools, immersive experiences, and the infrastructure that makes them real.

## About
CyberWorld Builders is the name on the workshop door. Jay is an engineer, lifelong tinkerer, music obsessive, and horror fan. The site is a map of what he is learning and making, not a catalog of services.

Current coordinates:
- Day work: full-time with Platinum.
- Independent work: a few long-running client collaborations.
- CyberWorld: personal systems, creative experiments, and ideas followed all the way through.

## Interests in progress
- **Agents as instruments**: the memory, tools, and operating systems around AI that let people and agents do difficult work together. Start with: https://cyberworldbuilders.com/blog/stop-wrapping-the-frontier-harness
- **Media that listens back**: music and film as material to explore, annotate, learn from, and reshape with human judgment in the loop. Start with: https://cyberworldbuilders.com/blog/rznjn-human-ai-music-collaboration
- **Technology with atmosphere**: interactive horror, mixed reality, puzzles, and physical systems where the technology serves the feeling. Start with: https://cyberworldbuilders.com/blog/occult-artifact-ar-wrapper-puzzle-fun
